depiction.primary_object: dial or clock face with single hand pointing upper-left
modifiers: five dots forming right half-circle rim

readings.meaning: self-timer or delay setting (e.g. camera, appliance)
time limit, duration, or Pomodoro interval

ambiguity: Can be confused with a generic clock, a loading spinner, a volume/dimmer knob, or a camera self-timer setting icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: elapsed vs remaining time, or ticking countdown steps

task_intents: buy or replace a physical timer
set up a Pomodoro work timer

reasoning: The half-solid, half-dotted circle with a single pointer is the standard Material glyph for a countdown timer or self-timer. It fits tasks centered on physical or digital timers (kitchen timers, plug/irrigation timers, Pomodoro apps, shutoff delays), though it should not be used merely because a task mentions a duration or deadline.
